Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Editorial clarification No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified. Adopted numerical method Assemble physical P1 gradients/areas, eliminate boundary data and solve sparse systems.
